name: Jain Resource Recycling Limited
summary: Jain Resource Recycling Limited engages in the recycling scraps of non-ferrous metals, and non-metallic materials in India and internationally. The company offers lead and lead alloy ingots, copper and copper alloys and ingots, and aluminum and aluminum alloys. It also engages in the non-ferrous metals and other commodities; processing of precious metals, such as gold and silver; and manufactures zinc products.
